entries.note_hr: Na Bikčevićevoj stazi, oko 300 metara od donjeg početka nalazi se prepreka - srušeno stablo preko uskog dijela puta uz strminu.
entries.note_en: On the Bikčević trail, about 300 metres from the lower start, there is an obstacle - a fallen tree across a narrow section of the path along a steep slope.

entries.note_hr: Cesta Babić Siča - Zavižan otvorena je za promet samo od petka do nedjelje, ostalim danima je zatvorena.
entries.note_en: The Babić Siča - Zavižan road is open to traffic only from Friday to Sunday and is closed on other days.
